Hi! I'm completely new to this and don't know where to start, can you guide me?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
No worries — getting started with Nurosym is pretty simple. Here’s the easiest way to begin:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump on the front of your ear).
Clip the earpiece to your left ear, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn the device on.
Slowly increase the energy until you feel a light, pleasant tingling sensation. 
Then just keep it on for 15–60 minutes per session while you read, work, meditate, or relax. Many people use it daily, often in the morning or split between morning and evening. 
Tip: start with lower intensity and shorter sessions, and always keep the sensation comfortable. 
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s a good idea to speak with our clinical team before starting.
